edits.reason: Lesson teaches the set-and-forget discipline by name: 'On set and forget: know your invalidation, your risk, your target — then walk away.' The chart shows the trade built around the DBS zone (84-89) but draws neither the invalidation nor the target it explicitly names. Stop line at 83 sits just under the DBS zone / band wick edge (legs bottom out at 87, wicks ~85), pink because it is a stop guarding a long. Target at 116 is the final leg .to (band top), gold per the TP-magnet palette convention. Both are within the ~85-118 visible band.
